purpose: Fresh-context outcome QA for wording and visual documentation, not code review.

criteria.detail: The automated authored-file scan excludes dependencies, generated output, Git metadata, and immutable Empirical history and reports no case-insensitive matches.
The catalog, package description, plugin description, and README use direct Action Topbar language while preserving the SDK/core warning.
Both stable docs/media PNG paths exist at 1450 by 720 and the README uses descriptive theme-specific alt text.
Twenty-four Action Topbar tests, typechecking, build, and the root repository check pass.
The inspected light capture is a real BB thread with the Action Topbar launcher open.
The inspected dark capture is the matched real BB state with the Action Topbar launcher open.
